{{Quote|The first surprise the belt had in store, however, was the discovery of strange patterns of ancient runes we found etched into the sides of several asteroids while performing a routine topographical scan of grid sector 867-3A4.|Korren Starchaser|<ref name="SD" />}}
[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Korren Starchaser]] led an [[Serias expedition|expedition]] to the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]] that uncovered evidence of an advanced [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species'''. Starchaser found several bits of evidence for the [[Species/Legends|species's]] existence: the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serias]], which was located in the same [[Star system/Legends|star system]], was inhabited, and the [[Serianan Belt]] contained [[Serianan runes|runes]] in various sizes that, due to the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]' density, suggested that they had been created by beings with access to tools that required more power to operate than anything known to Starchaser's team. Starchaser also discovered five [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Serianan statue|statues]]. The scout guessed that the creators of these artifacts were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] but not [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. The team gathered the statues, logged the runes, and departed to analyze their data. Afterward, a team of alien [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]] [[Second expedition to the Serianan system|discovered]] the Serianan system's mysteries and began their own analysis. A followup [[Third expedition to the Serianan system|visit]] by the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]] discovered the independent [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] as well as prospectors who sought to exploit the asteroids. A later group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] was kidnapped by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and brought to a base that resembled one of the Serianan statues.

==Biology and appearance==
After [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Korren Starchaser]], a member of the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]], uncovered evidence of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]], he and his team analyzed the artifacts left behind by these beings to ascertain details about their creators. Based on the size of [[Serianan runes|runes]] discovered within a large [[The Gulch|cavern]] in the [[Serianan Belt]] of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], Starchaser surmised that their makers were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] but [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]], and in fact quite different from [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="SD" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:Serias_runes.png|thumb|left|Korren Starchaser copied down the Serianan runes for further analysis.]]
The runes discovered by the New Republic scouts suggested that their makers were [[Starship/Legends|spacefaring]] beings with advanced technology. Some of the runes were as large as several [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ships]] placed end to end, and others were only visible to certain [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], which indicated that their creators had access to construction methods unknown to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Similarly, the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] content of the asteroids was incredibly dense, which made it difficult to carve; that fact led Starchaser to suggest that the species's tools required far greater energy output than anything known to his team.<ref name="SD" />

The makers of the Serianan runes also created [[Serianan statue|statues]] of alien buildings with domes, stairways, and doors. The sculptures were constructed from the same minerals as the asteroids, but the density of the statues was lower than the surrounding [[rock]], a fact that allowed an average humanoid to lift one with ease. The statues were 0.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and one meter wide; they were rust orange in [[Color/Legends|color]] and completely opaque. The five examples discovered by the New Republic team resisted attempts to scan them to determine whether they were hollow. A sixth sculpture was in the possession of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who inhabited a nearby [[Unidentified pirate base|base]] shaped like one of the statues. The statues joined to form a ring of about two meters in width.<ref name="SD" />

==History==
[[File:Serianan_Belt.jpg|thumb|right|New Republic scouts discovered alien artifacts in the Serianan Belt.]]
New Republic scout Korren Starchaser [[Serias expedition|led]] a team to the Serianan system. There, his team discovered that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serias]], a terrestrial world, was inhabited. However, the team also found runes carved into the sides of the asteroids that made up the Serianan Belt. The team devoted the remainder of the expedition to cataloging the runes and exploring a large cavern in one of the asteroids, which the team named the Gulch. In the depression, they found more runes as well as five stone statues sheltered in a niche in the rock. The team collected the statues and copied down the runes for further analysis. Starchaser decided to keep the expedition under wraps and to avoid contact with the inhabitants of Serias until he could bring the artifacts and writing to the attention of [[Maxina Sensis]], a [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] who worked at [[Daxis Outpost]] in the [[Jandolhoon system/Legends|Jandolhoon system]]. By following that procedure, Starchaser hoped to prevent the Serianan system and its inhabitants from being exploited by outsiders.<ref name="SD" />

Nevertheless, word reached Starchaser that his find had been leaked. That led to fear that [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|remnant]] factions might claim the find. Meanwhile, after initial analysis of the Serianan artifacts, Sensis advocated sending another expedition to gather more data. In the interim, a group of independent, non-Human archaeologists [[Second expedition to the Serianan system|arrived]] at the Serianan system and investigated the runes there. They made considerable progress into deciphering the writing and the history of its creation, as well as the relationship between the runes and the statues. However, the newcomers' procedures were not as secretive of those of the New Republic scouts, and prospectors learned of the asteroids and came to exploit them.<ref name="SD" />

{{RPGseed}}
The New Republic Scout Service [[Third expedition to the Serianan system|dispatched]] another group to follow up on the earlier research in the Gulch. There, they encountered the non-Human team of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]. The two factions allied with one another to keep the interloping prospectors from the find and to share data.<ref name="SD" />

Later, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] traveled to the Serianan system to search for the missing alien statue at the behest of their patron. En route, they were stopped and kidnapped by pirates, who brought them to their hidden base. The structure resembled a massive replica of one of the Serianan sculptures. The captives investigated the connection between the pirates, the statues, and their creators. They also found the missing Serianan statue, stole it, escaped, and brought the statue back to their patron.<ref name="SD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The details surrounding the discovery of the Serianan runes and statues are detailed in the article "[[Scouts' Dispatch]]," which was published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]] in [[November]] [[1995]]. The article, written by [[Peter Woodworth]], consists of an [[in-universe]] report from New Republic scout Korren Starchaser. The piece fails to establish the veracity of Starchaser's suppositions about the makers of the runes and statues he discovers.<ref name="SD" /> The ''Adventure Journal'' issue includes two adventure seeds for gamemasters of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' to use; this article assumes the scenarios play out as described.
